_about: Rules for app/checking: pairing claimed amounts with receipt pages (blueprint section 6, decisions D23-D30, D33). Every value here was measured first; the trial behind each is named beside it.
_anchor: What makes a matched amount the receipt's total (O1, rule A4m+, tools/total_anchor_trial, 2026-09-24): it must be printed on a row carrying a total label (whole words in order; words of 4+ letters may differ by label_letter_slips OCR letter), or — total_label_above — right under a total label standing as its column's header (telebirr prints 'Settled Amount' above the value); never on a row carrying a not-total label (cash handed over, change, card, a total before discount) or a not-total mark (a percentage: a tax line).
_buyer_pin_labels: A PIN-shaped value after one of these on the same printed row that is not the company PIN: the receipt names a different buyer -> CAUTION (D13). Measured on 71 real pages: 0 wrong flags (tools/total_anchor_trial).
_repeats: Repeated receipt pages (D29, tools/duplicate_pages_trial, measured one document at a time): nearly identical words (shared / all, words of word_min_length+ characters), or the same printed date + the same time + a shared amount of at least amount_min. 9 of 15 re-captured receipts caught, 0 wrong; the same scan repeated is always caught.
_patterns: How the repeat check reads a page's dates (day-first), times and amounts.
_red_problems: Colour rule B (owner, D34; measured with tools/badge_colour_trial): red = no valid receipt (none found, a repeated page, one receipt for two claims, the company PIN missing when required, another buyer's PIN, a page that could not be read). Every other problem (date, amount) is yellow: a receipt is there but one detail does not match.
_badge: What a receipt page's badge says (owner, D35 '4b'): the problem word and the mismatch — {receipt} what the receipt prints (its total, its date nearest the claimed one), {claimed} the claim sheet's value, {page} the other copy of a repeated page; 'unknown' when a value cannot be read; 'date_not_on_sheet' when the claim sheet gives no date to compare. 'no_claim': a page no claimed amount is linked to.
